charts.title: K2-124 b: orbits around K2-124
charts.description: The orbits of K2-124's planets in this map from above, to scale, with K2-124 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Livingston et al. 2019 (2019AJ....157..102L), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname LIVINGSTON_ET_AL__2019): P 6.413651 d

charts.title: K2-124 b: its transit
charts.description: K2-124 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (45, 46, 72) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 197221381, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 8 minutes later to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 67 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 7-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 8 min late; 7-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 22 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
